book.name: LUUKA
book.title: oMwazi Mwinja gwa Yeesu Krisitu nk'oku LUUKA aguyandikaga

content: Yeesu afumya omulwala olusiku lw'eSaabato
Lusiku luguma lw'eSaabato, Yeesu aja kulya emwa muguma w'abakulu b'aBafarisaayo. Abaliiri ho booshi baliiri bamuloleereza.
Omuntu olwere endwala y'ogurhundiisa omubiri
aliiri embere za Yeesu.
Yeesu abaza abigiriza b'amarhegeko n'aBafarisaayo ntya: «K'amarhegeko meerhu mayemereere changwa nangwa omuntu ogufumya omulwala olusiku lw'eSaabato?»
Aliko baasira. Yeesu ava arhoola oyo mulwala, amufumya n'okumuleka agende.
Ashuba kubabaza ntya: «Nde omu mwabo nk'omugala changwa enka yaage egarhogera omu gishimu, ka ho n'aho arhakayikuula mo nachiro luli lusiku lw'eSaabato?»
Baabula echi bamushubiza.
Ochihirire elugulu nj'ayandagazwa
Yeesu abeere abona gurhe abalaalikirwe yi bachiishoga ebichumbi by'embere, abachiira ogu mugani:
«Nk'omuntu aguhamageere kuja kulya amango m'obuhya, orhajaaga kuyikala oku gichumbi ch'embere. Bulaala hali amango omuntu okengerwe gukulusha alaalikirwe,
owabalaalikaga wooyo n'owenyu akayinja gukubwira ntya: ‹Olekere oyuula muntu egichumbi.› Wanaja wagwarhwa n'eshoni z'okuja kuyikala oku gichumbi ch'enyuma.

Aliko, amango olaalikirwe, wanaja kuyikala oku gichumbi ch'enyuma, y'amango hano owakulaalikaga ayinja, akubwire ntya: ‹Mwira waani, oje kuyikala oku gichumbi ch'embere!› Ntyo, nji bwakubeera bukenge embere z'abantu booshi nji baaba bayikeere haguma naawe oku meeza.
Bulaala ngasi yeeshi ochizamwire nj'ayandagazwa, n'ochiyandageeze nj'azamuulwa.»
Okulaalika abakene

Yeesu ashuba kubwira ola wamulaalikaga ntya: «Amango warheganyiza abantu ebiryo by'ezuuba changwa by'egolo, orhalaalikaga abeera baawe, changwa beene benyu, changwa abantu b'omulala gwawe, changwa abatuuranyi baawe b'abachire. Bulaala nabo nji bakayinja gukulaalika, na ntyo wanaba wamajuhwa.
Aliko amango wahamagala abantu kulya oku lusiku lukulu, olaalike abakeene, ebirema, abahunzize n'empumi.
Ntyo, nji waaba mugishwa, kwenge boowe barhagwerhe echi bagakujuha omu gukugalulira! Aliko, nji waajuhwa amango m'ogufuuka kw'abakwaneene.»
Omugani gw'abantu barhenguhaga omulaali
Muntu muguma omu baliiri baalya haguma na Yeesu abeere ayunva ebyo binwa, aderha ntya: «Agishirwe ola nji waalya omu Bwami bwa Nnamahanga!»
Yeesu amushubiza ntya: «Haliiri muntu muguma warheganyaga biryo binene, analaalika bantu banene.
Egihe ch'okulya chagerere ho, arhuma omuja waage kubwira abalaalikirwe: ‹Muyinje, byooshi byarheganyizwe.›
Aliko booshi barhondera kuderha ngasi muguma echaarhuma arhabonekana. Omwambere amubwira ntya: ‹Nagulaga eshwa, bimpemere nje kulirhangula; nguhemere ombabalire.›
Owindi aderha ntya: ‹Nagulaga enka ekumi z'oguhingiisa, nguhemere ombabalire, naaja kulola akaba zaakola.›
Owindi aderha ntya: ‹Namayuusa gushaba, chocharhuma ntayinja!›

Oyo muja agaluka emwa nnahamwabo, amubalira ebyo byooshi. Nnahamwabo akaliha, abwira oyo omuja waage ntya: ‹Genda juba omu njira zineneenene n'omu zigekegeeke z'egishagala, oleerhe hano abakene, ebirema, empumi n'abahunzize.›
Omuja abeere amala kujira ntyo, aderha ntya: ‹Nnaweerhu, ebi wahemaga byajirirwe, aliko hanachiri ahakayikalwa!›
Nnahamwabo ava amubwira ntya: ‹Oje omu njira n'omu migenderano y'egishagala, oseeze abantu bayinje kuja omu nju, y'omu mwani muyunjula abantu.
Kwenge, mbabwirire byo, ntaaye mw'aba bantu bali balaalikirwe nji waalya oku biryo byaani.›»
Obulyo bw'ogukulikira Yeesu
Lusiku luguma abantu banene baliiri kulambagira haguma na Yeesu omu njira. Ahindamuka n'okubabwira ntya:
«Nk'omuntu ankulikiire arhanansiimire kulusha eshe, nyina, mukaage, abaana baage, beene baabo, bali baabo, chiro n'akalamo kaage, arhaakaba mwigirizwa waani.
N'omuntu orhaheekere omusalaaba
gwage n'okunkulikira, arhaakaba mwigirizwa waani.
«Nde omu mwabo, nk'ashondere kuyumbaka enju nene, arharhanga kuyikala aganje engulo y'ebyakoleesa n'okulola akaba agwerhe ebikulo by'okuyiyunjuza?
Kwenge, nk'arhondeere kuyumbaka n'akaba arhagalire kumala, aba nji baabona ntyo, nji bamushekera.
Baderha ntya: ‹Oyu muntu arhondeere kuyumbaka, aliko agambirwe kuyunjuza.›
Changwa mwami ohe, nk'ashondere kulwisa owindi mwami, orharhanga kuyikala n'oguchiibaza akaba oku misi y'abasoda baage bihumbi ekumi, akagala guhima oyo waabo oyinjire na basoda bihumbi makumyaabiri?
Akaba arhakagala, agarhumira oyo waabo abantu achiri hale b'okumubaza gurhe bakayunviikana n'omurhuula gube ho.
Nenyu ntyo kubinali! Ngasi yeeshi omu mwabo nk'arhalekere ebikulo byaage byooshi arhaakaba mwigirizwa waani.»
Omunyu gurhachiri mw'obununu
«Omunyu chiri chintu gikwiriire. Sy'aliko gugaheza obuloke, gurhe bakagugalulira bo?
Gurhachiri gwinja oku budaka changwa oku myaavu; banagukabula embuga. Ogwerhe amarhwi m'okuyunva, ayunve!»
